title: My 4 Favorite Aromatherapy Products to Help Boost Your Mood Naturally
summary: I use aromatherapy products daily to lift my mood and unwind. Here are my 4 favorite essential oils, diffusers, and scent tools – plus the science behind them.
body_markdown:
## The 4 Best Aromatherapy Products Worth Trying


Smell is pretty personal, so you'll probably want to experiment with different kinds of products to see what notes and delivery methods resonate with you the most, and where they might best fit into your routine. For some inspiration to get started with, here are four aromatherapy products I return to again and again.


1.


#### Plant Therapy Essential Oils


A quality essential oil is one of the best investments you can make to harness the power of scent. If you're hunting for the best essential oils for anxiety or an everyday mood lift, a versatile bottle or two is the place to start. I like[Plant Therapy](https://www.planttherapy.com/) for their variety of scents, third-party testing to ensure purity, organic options, and well-priced sampler sets. A couple of my favorites are the organic Sweet Orange and organic Lemongrass – both bright, uplifting, and perfect for a morning or mid-day pick-me-up. Use a few drops in a diffuser or a DIY room spray, or mix into a carrier oil (like jojoba oil) and use in a roll-on on pulse points.


2.


#### Vitruvi Stone Diffuser


I recently acquired a[Vitruvi Stone Diffuser](https://vitruvi.com/products/stone-essential-oil-diffuser?variant=41381103763636) and have no regrets. Widely considered one of the best on the market, it's ceramic, quiet, and genuinely beautiful. One of the underrated essential oil diffuser benefits is double duty: this vase-like diffuser also works as a humidifier, a major bonus if you live in a dry climate like me.


3.


#### Kitsch Lavender Weighted Satin Eye Mask


[This sleep mask](https://www.mykitsch.com/products/the-lavender-weighted-satin-eye-mask) – silky soft and ever-so-slightly weighted – is filled with dried lavender seeds, so it carries a wonderfully soothing scent. Given the[well-documented](https://doi.org/10.1097/HNP.0000000000000528) lavender essential oil benefits for relaxation and rest, it's an easy win. I sometimes use it when I'm having[sleep problems](https://lifestance.com/services/sleep-disorder-treatment/) , but more often for mid-day lie-downs. Whether or not I actually drift off, the lavender helps me make the most of those few minutes I spend relaxing before tackling the rest of my afternoon.


4.


#### Body Restore Shower Steamers


An easy way to up the rejuvenation factor in your daily shower? Bring in some scent. I prefer to purchase dried eucalyptus at my local farmers market – just hang a bundle from the shower head and let the steam naturally diffuse the clarifying scent. As a handy alternative,[Body Restore shower steamer](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08BC88KG1?lv=shuf&th=1&channelId=500&plpRedirect=mhFallback) packs are well-reviewed and convenient. Made with real essential oils (like eucalyptus mint, tea tree, or rose petal), they release a burst of scent, kind of like a bath bomb for the shower.


However you like your scent – diffused, dabbed on, or steamed into your shower – the real beauty of aromatherapy products is how easily they slot into a day you're already living. Start with one that speaks to you, notice how it shifts your mood, and build from there.
